review.method: Deterministic illustration compositing and FFmpeg; no model-generated video.
review.layout: Seven-row shelf and headline retained. One row-four fruit match is animated.
fidelity_limits: Final selected flat image is goods-puzzle-flat-v2.png. Its small tonal variations are inherited; the animation adds no gradients, shading or glow.

The existing tutorial hand and translucent carton are isolated. Covered portions of central rows four to six are reconstructed from matching visible flat product art and source-verified hidden item types. This is a compositing approximation.
A flat printed SOLD OUT marker represents the existing source-game cleared-cell state. No additional in-frame HUD labels are introduced.
Uses the final reviewed flat illustration; deterministic local compositing, without paid generation or a game-engine render.
One fruit carton moves into the vacant middle slot of row-four left. Exactly three cartons clear; no invented whole-level victory, currency or reward.
Fixed portrait camera. Cel-style anticipation, squash and snap; only solid ink accents, rings, sharp stars and impact lines. No added shadows, glow, gradients or light particles.
The exact plan narration is read by the installed Samantha voice with the same locally synthesized stereo music and synchronized original SFX.

The enlarged hand and restored hidden shelves use cutout compositing; minor edge and texture differences remain at close inspection. This is a motion-design mockup, not pixel-perfect gameplay footage or a Unity implementation.
review.audio: Exact plan narration with installed Samantha voice plus synthesized SFX/music.
review.summary: Five encoded frames were inspected: initial shelf, pickup/drag, three-carton match, flat ink pop, and the single SOLD OUT end state. The full shelf and headline stay visible; the source slot is empty after the move.
